name: TallyQA
intro: TallyQA是一个开放式视觉计数问答基准，包含简单计数题和需要属性、关系或位置推理的复杂计数题，共287907道题。
build_method: 混合：导入、合成与人工标注
task_type: 视觉问答, 计数推理
build_method_en: Hybrid: imported, synthetic, and human annotated
eval_feature_en: Separate simple and human-vetted complex test splits
intro_en: TallyQA is an open-ended visual counting QA benchmark containing both simple object-counting questions and complex questions that require attribute, relational, or positional reasoning, with 287,907 questions in total.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with TallyQA AAAI 2019 paper Section 3 and official manoja328/TallyQA_dataset repository. TallyQA combines imported and newly collected open-ended counting questions. Questions beginning with How many and having integer answers from zero through fifteen are imported from VQA2 and Visual Genome; VQA2 items require agreement from at least five of ten annotators. The authors also import synthetic TDIUC questions and construct absent-object zero-count items. Targeted AMT tasks with about 800 annotators produce 19,500 complex questions over 17,545 images; nonzero questions must include counterexamples and a separate task creates hard zero-answer questions. The authors manually remove low-quality or insufficiently complex items. A conservative linguistic classifier strips generic image phrases, applies spaCy POS tagging, and labels a question simple only when it contains one noun and no adjective or adverb. The final 287,907 questions comprise 211,430 simple and 76,477 complex items. Train has 249,318 questions; Test-Simple has 22,991 imported questions; Test-Complex has 15,598 human-vetted AMT questions. Test images come only from Visual Genome and do not overlap training. Evaluation predicts an open-ended integer and reports exact accuracy and RMSE separately on Test-Simple and Test-Complex.
